notes: 0..8 listed slots (repeats allowed) over 8 slot headers, some skipped by header word +7; each slot holds up to six random packets of every handled type with their lengths, ended by an end packet, a type below 0x0b or above 0x4f, or an unknown type; one random handler may set the stop flag; the lost-link flag on or off with a logging error hook; every handler stub logs its type and arguments (only the type for handlers without one).
